props.name: label
props.description: Accessible description — what the bars represent.

props.name: bars
props.description: Bar count. Ignored when `values` is given.

props.name: values
props.description: Fixed heights, 0–1. Supply these to draw a real signal.

props.name: playing
props.description: Animate the bars. With `values`, the bars breathe around their height.

props.name: progress
props.description: Fraction already played, 0–1. Bars behind it stay lit.

props.name: barWidth
props.description: Width of one bar in pixels.

props.name: mirrored
props.description: Mirror the bars around the centre line, as an editor waveform does.
